#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The backup destination can be given as the first argument, or via the
# DEST / BACKUP_DEST environment variables.  It may be a local directory
# (for example /mnt/backups) or a remote scp target (host:/path).
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
    DEST=$1
else
    DEST="${DEST:-${BACKUP_DEST:-}}"
fi

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: backup destination is not set (pass it as an argument or set DEST/BACKUP_DEST)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp -q "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
